description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [MAG and MND +50% (25s)], [Attach Water with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Water Mode I (Gogo (V))] and [Water Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Water Mode I (Gogo (V))
description.text: Water abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Water abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Dual Trench Mimicry after using Water abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1], [Dual Deepsea Mimicry Mode] and [Dual Awoken Water Mode II (Gogo (V))], removes [Dual Awoken Water Mode I (Gogo (V))]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Deepsea Mimicry Mode
description.text: Mimicked abilities deal 50% more damage, casts the last ability used by any ally when another ally casts a Water abilities, removed after triggering three times

description.name: Dual Awoken Water Mode II (Gogo (V))
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap by 10000, Water abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Water abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Dual Trench Mimicry
description.text: Four single attacks (2.04 each), causes [DEF, RES and MND -50% (8s)] every second use, grants [Quick Cast 1] to all allies

description.name: Attach Water with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3
